b: I was into habitual Sunday meal preps for just about three years. I’d share my preps very frequently in this sub. After a nine month full gut renovation of my house and the birth of my first child I’m finally getting back into after almost a year off.
So excited to get back into the groove and start prepping for my baby too.
I gained 40 lb since I stopped prepping my meals. It’s time to get back into my good habits and eating clean.
My weekly prep consist of ground chicken baked on a sheet pan, broccoli, potatoes, and green beans.

This was also my first prep for my daughter. I baked and puréed squash, acorn squash, broccoli, sweet potatoes, and pumpkin. I’ll freeze these into a silicone tray and take them out the day I want to use them.
